products.title: CRGO Mother Coils
products.subtitle: Premium Electrical Steel Coils
products.description: High-quality CRGO (Cold-Rolled Grain-Oriented) mother coils are the primary source material for manufacturing transformer cores and other electromagnetic devices. Sourced from world-class mills, our mother coils ensure low core loss and high permeability.

features.title: Superior Magnetic Properties
features.description: Optimized for low core loss and high efficiency, our CRGO coils are ideal for high-performance transformers.

features.title: Wide Range of Grades
features.description: Available in various grades and thicknesses to meet diverse manufacturing and performance requirements.

faqs.question: What standards do your CRGO mother coils meet?
faqs.answer: Our coils comply with major international standards, including IEC, ASTM, and JIS, ensuring they meet global quality and performance benchmarks.

faqs.question: Can you provide coils with specific dimensions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can supply mother coils in various widths and thicknesses. Custom dimensions are available upon request to fit your manufacturing process.

products.title: CRGO Slit Coils
products.subtitle: Precision-Cut Electrical Steel
products.description: Our CRGO slit coils are precision-cut from mother coils to meet your exact width requirements. These custom-sized coils are ready for direct use in your lamination or core manufacturing lines, reducing waste and improving efficiency.

features.title: High-Precision Slitting
features.description: Cut to your exact specifications with minimal burr and tight tolerances, ensuring smooth and efficient processing.

features.title: Fully Customized
features.description: Specify the exact width, weight, and grade you need, and we will deliver coils tailored to your production line.

faqs.question: What is the minimum and maximum width for slit coils?
faqs.answer: We can slit coils to a wide range of widths, typically from 20mm up to 1250mm. Contact us to discuss your specific width requirements.

faqs.question: How are the slit coils packaged?
faqs.answer: Our slit coils are securely packaged with protective materials and mounted on custom skids to prevent damage during transit and ensure easy handling at your facility.

products.title: CRGO Lamination
products.subtitle: High-Performance Transformer Laminations
products.description: CRGO laminations are stamped or laser-cut from electrical steel and form the core of transformers. Our laminations are designed for optimal magnetic flux, minimal energy loss, and long-term reliability.

features.title: Custom Shapes and Sizes
features.description: We manufacture laminations in standard E&I, UI, and custom shapes to meet your specific transformer design.

features.title: Enhanced Performance
features.description: Designed to minimize eddy currents and hysteresis losses, improving the overall efficiency of the transformer.

faqs.question: What is the stacking factor of your laminations?
faqs.answer: Our CRGO laminations are manufactured to achieve a high stacking factor, typically above 98%, which maximizes the iron content in the core and improves performance.

faqs.question: Do you offer coating options for laminations?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide various insulation coatings (such as C5 and C6) to reduce inter-laminar losses and enhance the durability of the core.

products.title: CRGO Core Assembly
products.subtitle: Fully Assembled Transformer Cores
products.description: Our CRGO core assemblies are expertly constructed from high-quality laminations to form the magnetic backbone of a transformer. Each assembly is precisely built and tested to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

features.title: Precision Assembly
features.description: Assembled with meticulous care to ensure tight joints, accurate dimensions, and optimal magnetic performance.

features.title: Rigorous Quality Testing
features.description: Every core assembly undergoes comprehensive testing for core losses, magnetization, and dimensional accuracy.

faqs.question: What types of core assemblies do you manufacture?
faqs.answer: We manufacture a wide range of core assemblies, including stacked cores, wound cores, and step-lap designs for various types of transformers and reactors.

faqs.question: Can you build a core assembly based on our design?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in building custom core assemblies based on customer drawings and specifications to meet unique performance and dimensional requirements.

products.title: CRGO Core Coil Assembly
products.subtitle: Integrated Transformer Assemblies
products.description: A complete, ready-to-use assembly that includes both the CRGO core and the electrical windings (coils). This integrated solution simplifies transformer manufacturing by providing a fully tested and pre-assembled unit.

features.title: Fully Integrated Solution
features.description: Combines the magnetic core and electrical coils into a single, pre-assembled, and tested unit for easy integration.

features.title: Enhanced Reliability
features.description: Professionally assembled and tested to ensure perfect compatibility between the core and coils, maximizing performance and lifespan.

faqs.question: What type of windings do you use?
faqs.answer: We use high-quality copper or aluminum windings, depending on the customer's specifications and the application requirements for conductivity and cost-effectiveness.

faqs.question: Is the core coil assembly ready to be placed in a tank?
faqs.answer: Yes, our core coil assemblies are delivered fully assembled and tested, ready for final integration into the transformer tank.

products.title: Amorphous Core
products.subtitle: Ultra-High Efficiency Cores
products.description: Amorphous metal cores offer significantly lower core losses compared to traditional CRGO steel, making them ideal for high-efficiency transformers. Their unique atomic structure results in superior magnetic performance and energy savings.

features.title: Ultra-Low Core Loss
features.description: Dramatically reduces no-load losses in transformers, leading to significant energy savings over the equipment's lifetime.

features.title: Robust and Durable
features.description: Constructed to be mechanically strong and resistant to magnetic degradation, ensuring long-term reliability.

faqs.question: How do amorphous cores compare to CRGO cores?
faqs.answer: Amorphous cores have much lower hysteresis and no-load losses, resulting in higher energy efficiency. However, they have a lower saturation point, making them ideal for distribution transformers.

faqs.question: Are amorphous cores suitable for all transformer types?
faqs.answer: They are best suited for distribution transformers where no-load losses are a critical factor. For power transformers, CRGO steel is often preferred due to its higher magnetic saturation.

products.title: Oil Immersed Circuit Breaker
products.subtitle: Reliable Power System Protection
products.description: Oil-immersed circuit breakers are essential safety devices used to protect electrical circuits from damage caused by overload or short circuits. The oil acts as a coolant and arc-quenching medium, ensuring reliable operation.

features.title: Superior Arc Quenching
features.description: Utilizes high-dielectric mineral oil to effectively extinguish electrical arcs, ensuring safe and reliable circuit interruption.

features.title: Durable and Long-Lasting
features.description: Built with a robust tank and high-quality components for long service life and minimal maintenance requirements.

faqs.question: What voltage levels are your circuit breakers rated for?
faqs.answer: We offer oil-immersed circuit breakers for a wide range of medium to high voltage applications. Please provide your specific voltage requirements for a suitable recommendation.

faqs.question: What maintenance is required for these circuit breakers?
faqs.answer: Regular maintenance includes checking the oil level and quality, inspecting contacts, and testing the tripping mechanism to ensure continued reliable operation.

products.title: Wound Cores
products.subtitle: High-Performance Toroidal and C-Cores
products.description: Wound cores are constructed by winding electrical steel tape into a final shape, such as a toroid or C-core. This design offers a closed magnetic path, resulting in high efficiency, low stray magnetic fields, and a compact size.

features.title: Compact and Efficient Design
features.description: The closed magnetic path of wound cores minimizes flux leakage and results in a smaller, lighter, and more efficient design.

features.title: Low Noise Operation
features.description: The uniform winding and gapless construction lead to very low audible noise, making them ideal for noise-sensitive applications.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a wound core and a stacked core?
faqs.answer: Wound cores have a continuous, unbroken magnetic path, which results in higher efficiency and lower stray fields compared to stacked cores, which are assembled from individual laminations.

faqs.question: What materials are used for your wound cores?
faqs.answer: We use a variety of materials, including CRGO steel, amorphous metal, and nanocrystalline alloys, to create wound cores that meet specific performance requirements.

products.title: Toroidal Cores
products.subtitle: Efficient and Compact Ring Cores
products.description: Toroidal cores are ring-shaped wound cores that offer the highest possible efficiency and a very low external magnetic field. Their compact shape and superior performance make them ideal for a wide range of applications, including medical devices, audio equipment, and power supplies.

features.title: Maximum Efficiency
features.description: The uniform, gapless winding results in a highly efficient magnetic circuit with minimal energy loss and heat generation.

features.title: Compact and Lightweight
features.description: Toroidal cores are smaller and lighter than traditional E-I cores of the same power rating, saving space and weight.

faqs.question: Why are toroidal cores considered more efficient?
faqs.answer: Their ring shape and continuous winding create a closed magnetic circuit with no air gaps, which dramatically reduces magnetic flux leakage and energy loss.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom-sized toroidal cores?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can manufacture toroidal cores in a wide range of sizes and with various material options to perfectly match your application's power and performance needs.
